description:
Building and growing products for curious, ambitious people who want to learn and keep getting better. Wanna join the tribe?

Why This Role Exists

We build mobile apps used by millions of people worldwide and that means every detail matters: performance, clarity, smooth interactions, and fast iteration.

This role is for someone who wants to learn how real consumer mobile products are built and scaled.

You won’t just implement tickets. You’ll learn how mobile engineering connects with product thinking, experimentation, and user behavior.

You’ll work closely with Product and Design and understand how features move from idea to shipped experience.

What You’ll Learn & Do

You’ll learn how to build and improve real mobile features inside apps used at scale.

You’ll

  • Develop features using React Native.
  • Collaborate with designers to translate flows into smooth mobile experiences.
  • Fix bugs and improve performance.
  • Understand release cycles and CI/CD basics.
  • Use AI tools to speed up development and debugging.
  • Think beyond code — about how users actually experience what you build.

You’ll ship real improvements early on.

Tech You’ll Work With

React Native, iOS & Android ecosystems, CI/CD pipelines, and modern design systems.

You don’t need to master everything on day one — you’ll grow into it by building.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone with solid programming fundamentals and curiosity about mobile apps.

If you enjoy building things people actually use, care about clean code, and want to understand how product decisions shape engineering, you’ll fit in well.

Required Skills

  • JavaScript
  • React Native
  • Debugging
  • Curiosity
  • Ownership

If you want to learn how high-quality consumer mobile apps are built and ship things that reach millions, this is a great place to grow.
